guidewords.name: Direct radiation
guidewords.prompt: Exposure to radiation from sources, process streams, waste or gaps in shielding.

guidewords.name: Loss of shielding
guidewords.prompt: Removal, degradation or bypass of shielding; incorrect source positioning.

guidewords.name: Contamination
guidewords.prompt: Spread of loose or airborne radioactive contamination; loss of contamination control.

guidewords.name: Loss of confinement
guidewords.prompt: Failure of containment barriers, ventilation cascade or filtration; leaks of radioactive material.

guidewords.name: Criticality
guidewords.prompt: Accumulation of fissile material; loss of mass, geometry, moderation or concentration control.

guidewords.name: Decay heat
guidewords.prompt: Loss of heat removal from fuel, waste or sources; overheating.

guidewords.name: Radioactive waste
guidewords.prompt: Generation, handling, storage or transfer of solid, liquid or gaseous radioactive waste.

guidewords.name: Radiolysis / hydrogen
guidewords.prompt: Flammable gas generation by radiolysis or corrosion; accumulation in vessels or rooms.

guidewords.name: Internal fire
guidewords.prompt: Fire loads, ignition sources, fire spread between areas, impact on safety functions.

guidewords.name: Internal explosion
guidewords.prompt: Flammable gases, dusts or chemicals; pressure vessel failure.

guidewords.name: Internal flooding
guidewords.prompt: Pipe or tank failure, fire-fighting water, spray and drainage capacity.

guidewords.name: Dropped and impacting loads
guidewords.prompt: Lifting over fuel, sources or safety equipment; vehicle impacts.

guidewords.name: Internal missiles
guidewords.prompt: Rotating machinery, pressurised components, valve stems.

guidewords.name: High-energy line break
guidewords.prompt: Pipe whip, jet impingement, room pressurisation, environmental effects.

guidewords.name: Loss of HVAC
guidewords.prompt: Loss of ventilation, cooling or heating; extreme room conditions.

guidewords.name: Electromagnetic interference
guidewords.prompt: EMI/RFI affecting instrumentation and control equipment.

guidewords.name: Seismic
guidewords.prompt: Earthquake effects on structures, systems and components, including seismic interaction.

guidewords.name: Extreme weather
guidewords.prompt: High winds, extreme temperatures, snow, ice, hail.

guidewords.name: External flooding
guidewords.prompt: River, sea, extreme rainfall, failure of dams or site drainage.

guidewords.name: Lightning
guidewords.prompt: Direct strike and induced effects on electrical and I&C systems.

guidewords.name: Aircraft crash
guidewords.prompt: Accidental aircraft impact, fuel fire.

guidewords.name: Nearby industrial / transport accidents
guidewords.prompt: Explosions, toxic or flammable clouds from neighbouring sites, roads, rail or shipping.

guidewords.name: Biological / environmental
guidewords.prompt: Biofouling of intakes, wildfire, dust or sand storms.

guidewords.name: Loss of electrical power
guidewords.prompt: Loss of off-site or on-site power; failure of back-up supplies.

guidewords.name: Loss of instrumentation and control
guidewords.prompt: Spurious signals, loss of indication, software faults, loss of protection systems.

guidewords.name: Loss of utilities
guidewords.prompt: Loss of cooling water, compressed air, steam or other support services.

guidewords.name: Overpressure / underpressure
guidewords.prompt: Blocked outlets, thermal expansion, vacuum collapse.

guidewords.name: Chemical / toxic release
guidewords.prompt: Release of process chemicals or toxic gases; chemical reactions.

guidewords.name: Ageing and obsolescence
guidewords.prompt: Degradation of materials, obsolete components, loss of spares.

guidewords.name: Operator error
guidewords.prompt: Wrong action, omission or sequence; workload; human–machine interface.

guidewords.name: Maintenance and testing error
guidewords.prompt: Errors during maintenance, calibration or testing; restoration errors.

guidewords.name: Procedures and training
guidewords.prompt: Missing, unclear or incorrect procedures; competence.

guidewords.name: Work at height
guidewords.prompt: Falls of persons or objects.

guidewords.name: Lifting operations
guidewords.prompt: Crane and hoist operations affecting personnel.

guidewords.name: Confined spaces
guidewords.prompt: Oxygen depletion, toxic atmospheres, access and rescue.

guidewords.name: Electrical safety
guidewords.prompt: Electric shock, arc flash.

guidewords.name: Hazardous substances
guidewords.prompt: Exposure to chemicals, asbestos, dusts.

guidewords.name: Manual handling
guidewords.prompt: Musculoskeletal injuries.

guidewords.name: Non-radiological discharges
guidewords.prompt: Releases to air, water or ground of non-radioactive pollutants.

guidewords.name: Security interface
guidewords.prompt: Conflicts between safety and security measures, e.g. access control versus evacuation.

likelihood.label: Extremely unlikely
likelihood.description: Not expected during the facility lifetime (< 1E-4 per year).

likelihood.label: Very unlikely
likelihood.description: Has occurred in the industry but not expected at this facility (1E-4 to 1E-3 per year).

likelihood.label: Unlikely
likelihood.description: Could occur once during the facility lifetime (1E-3 to 1E-2 per year).

likelihood.label: Possible
likelihood.description: Expected a few times during the facility lifetime (1E-2 to 1E-1 per year).

likelihood.label: Likely
likelihood.description: Expected several times; has occurred at this or similar facilities (> 1E-1 per year).

severity.label: Negligible
severity.description: No injury. No radiological consequence beyond planned operational exposure. Negligible damage.

severity.label: Minor
severity.description: First-aid injury. Small unplanned worker dose well within limits. Minor contamination confined to a controlled area.

severity.label: Moderate
severity.description: Lost-time injury. Unplanned worker dose approaching limits or spread of contamination on site. Limited plant damage.

severity.label: Major
severity.description: Serious injury or single fatality. Worker dose exceeding statutory limits or significant on-site release. Major plant damage.

severity.label: Catastrophic
severity.description: Multiple fatalities. Off-site radiological release requiring public protective measures. Loss of the facility.
